disputes.original: discriminating request: 'Drying shrink and grade results at Harlan Junction and Wexford during the Superintendent's absences, and at other cooperatives running the same tower-dryer models'
disputes.issue: E14 states there was no period in which either site operated without the Superintendent, so the first half of Q3 asks for data the case says does not exist; this is internally inconsistent and could make analyzers discount Q3.
disputes.resolution: Reworded Q3 to the data that can exist and still discriminates R3: results at other cooperatives running the same tower-dryer models without this Superintendent. Q3 remains discriminating.

disputes.issue: Possible refutation as association-only: the program's maintenance cut (~$0.3M) did mechanically add to FY2026 net savings, so a reader could argue a partial causal contribution rather than a contradicted link.
disputes.resolution: Expected answer kept. Rationale strengthened: removing the $0.3M still leaves $9.9M net savings, itself a record, and peers without any program had similar growth (E4), so the evidence counts against the program producing the record.
